default: # agy-github-worker-board [![GitHub Repo](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-rrivera%2Fagy--github--worker--board-blue.svg)](https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker-board) [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-89b4fa.svg)](https://antigravity.google) Live auxiliary-pane sidecar status board for agent-ready GitHub issue workflows in Antigravity. Companion UI plugin to [**`rrivera/agy-github-worker`**](https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker). --- ## Overview `agy-github-worker-board` runs as an Antigravity sidecar in the auxiliary side pane, providing real-time visibility into your GitHub issue automation without polluting the agent's context or spending tokens: - **Live Kanban Cards**: Displays stacked horizontal cards categorized across **Todo**, **In Progress**, **Waiting on User**, and **In Review**. - **Action Status Badges**: Identifies required attention at a glance (`NEEDS_PLAN`, `USER_REPLIED`, `NEEDS_REVISION`, `WAITING_ON_USER`). - **Direct GitHub Navigation**: Clickable links to issues, labels, and linked pull requests with author and diff status. - **Dynamic Search & Filtering**: Real-time client-side filter by issue title, number, labels, action status, or PR. - **Zero Token Overhead**: Operates entirely out-of-band via the GitHub CLI (`gh`), automatically refreshing every 30 seconds and reacting to workspace focus changes. --- ## Relationship with `agy-github-worker` | Package | Purpose | Installation | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | [**`agy-github-worker`**](https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker) | **Core Skill**: Autonomous execution engine (`/github-worker`), TDD cycles, 3-axis peer reviews. | Required for autonomous issue execution. | | [**`agy-github-worker-board`**](https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker-board) | **Companion UI**: Real-time visual auxiliary pane status board. | Optional companion for visual status tracking. | --- ## Directory Structure ```text agy-github-worker-board/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── package.json # Root test runner & project definition ├── README.md # Documentation ├── LICENSE # MIT license definition ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Plugin icon (vector) │ └── logo.png # Plugin icon (rendered PNG) └── sidecars/ └── github-worker-board/ ├── sidecar.json # Antigravity sidecar definition ├── package.json # Sidecar dependencies & test runner ├── main.mjs # Backend HTTP server & GitHub CLI data fetcher ├── index.html # Sidecar webview layout ├── styles.css # Antigravity-matching Catppuccin theme ├── app.js # Webview reactivity & DOM renderer └── test/ ├── app.test.mjs # Unit tests for UI rendering & logic └── main.test.mjs # Unit tests for server & API pipeline ``` --- ## Installation in Antigravity Install directly from GitHub via the Antigravity CLI: ```bash # Install the auxiliary sidecar board agy plugin install https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker-board ``` Restart or reload Antigravity. The board will appear in the auxiliary side pane, automatically detecting the repository of your active workspace. --- ## Testing Run the test suite from the repository root: ```bash npm test ``` All 50 unit and integration tests are executed using Node's native test runner (`node --test`). --- ## License MIT
